title: ExplainGuard: A Zero Trust Framework for Post-Hoc Explanation Integrity Guarantees in Blackbox XAI Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.21803v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As machine learning (ML) models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes environments, explainable AI (XAI) methods like SHAP and LIME have become essential for regulatory compliance and trust. However, the current auditing paradigm relies on an implicit "chain of trust" where third-party auditors are assumed to be trusted. Recent research demonstrates that this assumption is flawed and adversarial auditors can manipulate XAI explanations through manipulation attacks such as output shuffling or scaffolding out-of-distribution (OOD) to conceal model biases while maintaining high prediction accuracy aiming for fairwashed explanation. translated_title: ExplainGuard：一种用于黑盒XAI模型中事后解释完整性保障的零信任框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21803v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：随着机器学习（ML）模型越来越多地部署在高风险环境中，像SHAP和LIME这样的可解释人工智能（XAI）方法已成为法规遵从和信任的关键。然而，当前的审计范式依赖于一种隐性的“信任链”，即假定第三方审计师是可信的。近期研究表明，这一假设存在缺陷，对抗性审计师可以通过操纵攻击（如输出洗牌或构建分布外（OOD）脚手架）来操纵XAI解释，以隐藏模型偏见，同时保持高预测准确性，旨在实现“洗白解释”。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的防御框架ExplainGuard，它利用零信任架构（ZTA）设计，集成到XAI解释供应链中，确保生成解释的完整性。该框架有助于我们取代模糊的默认假设。
tldr: 本文提出ExplainGuard框架，采用零信任架构保障黑盒XAI模型解释的完整性，抵御审计师操纵攻击，取代不可靠的信任假设。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ExplainGuard, a zero-trust architecture framework that ensures the integrity of explanations in blackbox XAI models, defending against auditor manipulation attacks and replacing unreliable trust assumptions.
